audience: health-tech teams that retrieve patient records through Particle Health

useCases.title: Find a patient and read the clinical data
useCases.text: The AI searches for the patient by demographics and reads the clinical data in the flattened format. It sums up conditions and medications.

useCases.title: Check the status of a records retrieval
useCases.text: The AI reads the status of the latest completed records query for one patient: state, timing and the files that came back.

useCases.title: Pull one type of FHIR data
useCases.text: The AI retrieves only one resource type for a patient, such as conditions or observations, and lists the entries.

useCases.title: See which organizations the network can query
useCases.text: The AI searches the network participants by state or ZIP code. You see which organizations a records query can reach.

useCases.title: Register a patient and start a records query
useCases.text: The AI registers the patient with Particle and starts a nationwide records query, then checks its progress. It asks for your OK first.
